notablePrerequisites: You have at least one green card in hand.
description:
Activate Evolutionary Leap by paying {G} and sacrificing Temur Charger.
When Temur Charger dies, Yedora triggers, returning Temur Charger to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Evolutionary Leap ability, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and putting the creature card into your hand.
Activate Temur Charger by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Charger's morph ability by revealing a green card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.
